questions.expl: ：宋朝(960 年- 1279 年)，有一个叫张乖崖的官员在重阳县工作，即今天的湖北。 本题考查冠词的用法。句中"official"(官员)是可数名词单数，且此处表示泛指"一个官员"，并 非特指某个人。又因"official" 是以元音音素/ɒ/ 开头，所以应使用不定冠词"an"。故选C。
：多年来盗窃一直很常见，甚至县府钱库的钱也被盗了。 本题考查现在完成时的用法。句中"for years" 是现在完成时的标志性时间状语，强调动作从过去 开始持续到现在并可能继续下去。句子主语"theft" 是不可数名词，视为单数，因此应使用"has been"。故选C。
：一天，张见到一个级别不高的官员惊慌失措地走出保险库。 come 来，原形；comes 来，三单形式；came 来，过去式；to come 来，不定式结构。根据句式see sb do sth 看见某人做过某事，可知用动词原形。故选A。
：张拦住他问道：“你怎么这么着急？” on 在……上；in 在……里；at 在；for 对于。短语in a great hurry 匆忙地，可知用介词in。故选B。

：因此，他要求警卫仔细搜查这位小吏。 care 关心，动词；careful 小心，形容词；carefully 仔细地，副词；careless 粗心的，形容词。根据“Zhang remembered the things stolen from the vault.”可知张一定想仔细搜查这个小吏，副词修饰动词。故选 C。 6．句意：他发现一个铜板在头巾里。 he 他，主格；his 他的，形容词性物主代词；him 他，宾格；himself 他自己。名词前面用形容词性 物主代词。故选B。
：这位官员不承认他偷了别的东西。 something else 其他东西，用在肯定句中；else something 错误结构；anything else 其他东西，用在否 定句或疑问句中；else anything 错误结构。在否定句中，不定代词用anything ，形容词修饰不定代 词时放在后面，可知用anything else。故选C。
：你不能因此而杀了我！ can’t 不能；couldn’t 不能；mustn’t 不应该；needn’t 不必。本句为直接引语，引述原话用说话时的 时态，可知用一般现在时，小吏不能承认偷盗其他物品，认为不能杀他。故选A。
：如果你每天偷一枚硬币，一千天后就会有一千枚硬币。 are 是，一般现在时be 的复数形式；have 有，一般现在时非三单形式；will be 是，一般将来时； will have 有，一般将来时。根据条件状语从句的“主将从现”规则，从句时态为一般现在时，主句应 用一般将来时，表示将有“there will be”。故选C。
：这句话告诉我们，随着时间的推移，不断做一些小事可以带来很大的不同结果。 tell 告诉，动词原形；told 告诉，动词过去式；is told 告诉，被动语态，一般现在时，单数，tells 告诉，一般现在时，单数。此处叙述一个客观存在的事实用一般现在时态，主语是“this saying”,为 单数。故选D。
：这句话告诉我们，随着时间的推移，不断做一些小事可以带来很大的不同结果。 different 不同的；differently 不同地；difference 不同点；differences 不同点(复数)。短语make a difference 产生作用或影响，可知选difference。故选C。
：一方面，它提醒我们不要做小坏事。 not doing 动名词，否定形式；don’t do 否定形式；not to do 不定式，否定形式；to not do 错误结构。 remind sb not to do 提醒某人不要做某事，可知选不定式的否定形式。故选C。
：但如果你坚持几个月或几年，你就会成功。 unless 如果不；although 尽管；because 因为；if 如果。“ you stick to it for months or years”是“you will___” 的肯定条件，可知选if。故选D。
：习主席领导当地人民努力工作，摆脱贫困。 so 因此，连接因果关系；or 或者，连接选择关系；and 和，连接对等关系；but 但是，连接转折关 系。根据“work hard”和“get rid of poverty”是对等关系，可知选用并列连词and。故选C。
：为了明智地统治他的王国，他决定学习世界上所有的智慧。
：于是，他召集了王国和国外的所有智者，命令他们寻找书籍供他阅读和学习。 work out 解决；put away 收好；look for 寻找；pick up 捡起。根据下文“They carried 5,000 books full of wisdom.”可知，智者为国王寻找书籍。故选C。
：智者带着他们的骆驼回来了。 worked 工作；returned 返回；followed 跟随；left 离开。根据下文“They carried 5,000 books full of wisdom.”可知，智者寻找到书籍，回来交给国王。故选B。
：看到这么多书，国王很惊讶，不知道从哪里开始。 surprised 惊讶的；tired 疲惫的；special 特别的；angry 愤怒的。根据“he didn’t know where to start” 可知，不知从何开始，体现因数量多而震惊。故选A。
：又过去了五年。 lost 丢失；missed 错过；wasted 浪费；passed 通过。此处表示时间流逝，用passed。故选D。

：然而，国王仍然发现太多。 Luckily 幸运的是；However 然而；Also 也；Instead 反而。根据“The wise men brought back 50 books…the king still found there were too many.”的语境可知，此处句意发生了转折，B 项符合。故选 B。 22．句意：在接下来的几年里，智者们努力把所有的智慧都写进一本书中，并展示给国王看。 counted 数；wrote 写；showed 展示；taught 教。根据“the wise men worked hard to put all the wisdom into one book and…it to the king”的语境可知，此处指将成果展示给国王看。故选C。
：不幸的是，国王没有兴趣读这本书，也没有时间学习。 difference 区别；use 用途；skill 技能；interest 兴趣。根据“the king showed no…in reading this book, nor did he have time to learn from it”的语境并结合选项可知，此处指他既无兴趣也无时间。故选D。
：他的王国爆发了许多问题，如战争和疾病，但他没有智慧来解决这些问题。 make 制造；solve 解决；find 发现；cause 导致。根据“wars and diseases”可知，此处指没有智慧来 解决战争和疾病等问题。故选B。
：如果不采取行动，就不会有进展。 action 行动；sign 迹象；time 时间；mind 头脑。根据上文“Waiting for wisdom to come to you is just a way of being lazy.”可知，等待智慧降临只是懒惰的一种方式，此处强调行动的重要性。故选A。

questions.stem: Which of the following subjects do the three folk games have to do with?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“As a country powerful inmath, China has many folk games which are full of mathwisdom (智慧).”可知，三个游戏都与数学相关。故选C。

questions.stem: Which is first popular in the Ming and Qing dynasties?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“First popular in the Ming and Qing dynasties, the tangram is a puzzle made up of seven pieces of different shapes.”可知，七巧板最早流行于明清时期。故选A。

questions.stem: What can we learn from the text?
opts: There are Luban locks made up of only six pieces now.
The tangram was brought to the West in the 19th century.
It is usually more difficult to unlock a Luban lock than to put it back together.
Players have to remove nine rings from the handle to win the nine linked rings puzzle.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“And it is usually made upof nine rings connected to a handle (手柄). Players have toremove (移除) all the rings from the handle to win thegame.”可知，它通常由九个环连接在一个 手柄上。玩家必须从手柄上摘下所有的圆环才能赢得比赛。故选D。

questions.stem: The writer wrote the text mainly to ________.
opts: explain the ways to learn math
share his skills of playing folk games
tell us the importance of learning math well
introduce folk games with math wisdom in China
questions.expl: 判断题。通读全文内容可知，作者写本文的主要目的是介绍九连环、七巧板和鲁班锁这三 个充满数学智慧的中国民间游戏。故选D。

questions.stem: Where can we probably read the text?
questions.expl: 判断题。本文主要介绍了三个与数学相关的民间游戏，所以可能在一本科学书里看到这 篇文章。故选B。

questions.stem: How old was Yu Gong when he decided to move the mountains?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“He was nearly 90 years old.”以及“One day, Yu Gong said to the whole family... Let our whole family try our best to move away these two mountains.”可知，愚公决定移山时快90 岁了。 故选B。

questions.stem: What does the underline word “inconvenient” mean in paragraph 2?
What did Yu Gong think of Zhi Sou?
opts: Zhi Sou would help move the mountains.
Zhi Sou didn’t laugh at him.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“You are not even as clever as a child.”可知，愚公认为智叟不聪明。故选A。

questions.stem: What’s the correct order of the events?a. Zhi Sou thought Yu Gong couldn’t move the mountains.b. The Emperor of Heaven helped to move away the mountains.c. His neighbor came to help him.d. Yu Gong gathered his family to move mountains.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Let our whole family try our best to move away these two mountains.”“ When her son heard of this, he also came to help happily”“ Can you move the mountains?”以及“and he helped

questions.stem: What can we learn from the story?
opts: An old woman can also make a difference.
Nothing is difficult if you put your heart into it.
Convenient transportation is very important to us.
In fact, Yu Gong could not move the two mountains.
questions.expl: 大意题。根据“They finally moved Emperor of Heaven, and he helped them move away these two mountains.”可知，故事中愚公一家坚持不懈移山，最终感动天帝达成目标，体现了“世上无难 事，只怕有心人”的道理。故选B。

questions.stem: What does Confucius say about the wise in “The Analects of Confucius”?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“子曰：‘知者不惑，仁者不忧，勇者不惧。’” 可知孔子在《论语》中说智 者不惑，也就是智者不困惑，不迷茫。故选C。

questions.stem: What does the underlined word “themselves” refer to?
What did Zhu Xi believe the most important thing is in life?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Zhu also pointed out that the most important thing in life is to be kind to others and have a heart full of kindness.” 可知朱熹认为人生中最重要的事情是表现出善良。故选C。

questions.stem: Why did the writer mentioned Zhu Xi as an example?
opts: Zhu Xi was a teacher at the same school as Wei Shengkun.
Zhu Xi’s ideas match what Wei Shengkun is talking about.
Zhu Xi was the only person who knew the world’s main rules.
Wei Shengkun likes Zhu Xi’s poems and thoughts better.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“Wei Shengkun is a Chinese teacher from the Affiliated High School of Peking University in Beijing.…believed that a truly wise person understands the main rules of the world.” 可知 作者提到朱熹是因为朱熹的观点与魏胜坤所谈论的内容相匹配。故选B。

questions.stem: Which of the following would be the best title for the passage?
opts: The Path to Happiness: Confucius’ TeachingsB．The Role of Education in Personal Growth
Zhu Xi’s Philosophy about Truth in Life
Looking for Truth to Be A Wise Man
questions.expl: 标题题。文章主要讲述了孔子在《论语》中的话以及朱熹对其的解读，强调了通过学习和 思考寻找世界的真理才能成为智者，克服不良情绪。选项D“寻找真理成为智者” 符合文章主旨。 故选D。
